newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila bourse head sees market rising further.
newsitem.headline: Manila bourse head sees market rising further.

text.p: Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) president Vitaliano Nanagas said on Thursday he sees the stock market surging further from its current record levels.

"I'm hoping this will continue. Even if we get a dip, I am willing to bet that the rest of the year will carry more record highs," Nanagas said in a television interview minutes after the main index ended at a record closing high of 3,392.76 points.
The market reached an all-time high of 3,404.80 shortly before the close, breaking a record set on Wednesday.
Nanagas said the strong performance of the Philippine economy had boosted investor confidence.

"By and large, the perception of everybody, both local and foreign investors, is that structural reforms are taking root and that we are on our way to continued sustainable development," Nanagas added.

Nanagas said that to further attract investors the exchange has started scripless trading early this month. He said that Jollibee Foods Corp and ABS-CBN Broadcasting Corp were the first counters to have gone scripless.
